pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-01.png with Read and looked at it. Top wide panel: the caption at top left reads 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' The doctor in a white coat stands in the clinic doorway and waves in an older woman in a lilac sari. Two patients sit in the waiting chairs on the right, seen from behind. There is no dialogue. Bottom-left panel: the receptionist in a blue kurta is on the phone and writing in a ledger, with patients in the foreground seen from behind. Her two balloons are read left then right: 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' and then 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' Both tails point down to her head. Bottom-right panel: the doctor stands thinking with her hand at her chin, and the receptionist is still on the phone in the background. Balloon: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' The tail points to the doctor.
pages.observation: The order is clear: caption, the receptionist's two balloons left to right, then the doctor's answer. The doctor's line answers the receptionist's complaint, and no reply is skipped. All text is legible. Tight spots: 'clinic.' in the top caption and 'details,' in the first receptionist balloon run very close to the right border of their boxes. The tail tip of 'Appointments...' ends at the top of the receptionist's hair. The tail tip of the doctor's balloon ends against her hair at the side of her head. Neither covers a face. No lettering covers hands or the phone or ledger. The doctor's name comes only from the caption, and that is enough.
